articles.title: China warns against turning Horn of Africa into geopolitical battleground
articles.description: With tensions in the Middle East threatening peace in the Horn of Africa, China is warning against turning the region into a geopolitical battleground. Chinese envoys have visited Ethiopia, Djibouti, Egypt and Eritrea this month.
